data.title: 霍尔海雅 · 旧唱片的旋律
data.description: 唱片有一点轻微的杂音，她却没有换掉。旋律走到熟悉的一段时，霍尔海雅用指尖轻轻跟着拍了两下。
data.action: 在唱片机旁侧耳听音乐
data.camera: 中景，唱片机在画面一侧
data.promptProse: Curled gracefully in a velvet armchair beside a vintage brass-horned phonograph in a moody salon, Ho'olheyak taps her fingers in time with a crackling jazz melody spinning on vinyl. Muted amber wall sconces, stacked record sleeves on a low credenza, and dancing shadows create an atmosphere of sultry, sophisticated evening leisure.
